name: Freeze-drying soft sediment before geological analysis
plain_name: Prepare a friable sediment core sample
description: A documented geological sample-preparation method,with sediment cups rather than fruit slices.
keywords: Prepare a friable sediment core sample

sources.citation: University of Minnesota CSD Facility freeze-drying method

requirements.rationale: Vacuum sublimation preserves a friable sediment preparation; a refrigerator by itself is insufficient.
Replicate the CSD facility's documented -50 C collector configuration; this is a selected facility-method requirement,not a universal sediment eutectic temperature.

missing_information: The facility gives no numeric vacuum,shelf-temperature,time-to-dry or mass-specific capacity; these remain unquantified rather than invented.
Collector rating is not a frozen sample-temperature measurement.
Complete drying must be checked experimentally; the verdict only covers the stated facility hardware prerequisites.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
